convert_sparse_to_dense_tensors: convert a list of sparse feature dictionaries into dense PyTorch tensors with presence masks
convert_string_keyed_sparse_data: convert string-keyed sparse feature dictionaries to dense tensors by casting keys to integers
convert_id_score_lists_to_tensors: convert weighted multi-categorical id-score list features into offset, id, and score tensors
process_sparse_with_zero_missing: process sparse data and set missing values to zero instead of the default MISSING_VALUE sentinel
build_feature_to_index_mapping: build a feature-to-index mapping from a sorted list of feature IDs for sparse-to-dense conversion
